results.title: Prefill-as-a-Service: KVCache of Next-Generation Models Could Go Cross-Datacenter
results.summary: Proposes PrfaaS, a cross-datacenter serving architecture that combines selective prefill offloading, bandwidth-aware scheduling, and cache-aware request placement, transferring KV cache over commodity Ethernet to local decode clusters.

results.title: DualPath: Breaking the Storage Bandwidth Bottleneck in Agentic LLM Inference
results.summary: Identifies that prefill-engine storage NICs become bandwidth-saturated during KV-Cache loading and introduces a dual-path scheme that routes KV-Cache to decode engines via RDMA, achieving up to 1.96x higher online serving throughput.

results.title: BanaServe: Unified KV Cache and Dynamic Module Migration for Balancing Disaggregated LLM Serving in AI Infrastructure
results.summary: Co-schedules attention-level KV Cache migration, layer-level weight migration, and a Global KV Cache Store to balance prefill/decode load in disaggregated serving, reporting 1.2x-3.9x higher throughput than vLLM.

results.title: OrbitFlow: SLO-Aware Long-Context LLM Serving with Hierarchical KV Cache Transfer
results.summary: Presents a hierarchical KV cache transfer system that schedules KV cache block movement across memory tiers under PCIe bandwidth constraints to meet SLOs for long-context inference.

results.title: Master KV cache aware routing with llm-d for efficient AI inference
results.summary: Documents how the llm-d Kubernetes-native framework performs state-aware, KV-cache-aware request scheduling and routing via the Gateway API Inference Extension so requests land on workers holding the relevant KV state.

results.title: How to Reduce KV Cache Bottlenecks with NVIDIA Dynamo
results.summary: Describes NVIDIA Dynamo's KV Block Manager and the NIXL data-transfer layer for offloading/migrating KV cache to remote network storage via RDMA and GPU Direct Storage, reporting up to 270 GB/s read throughput across eight GPUs.

results.title: Awesome-KV-Cache-Optimization (ACL 2026 Survey Companion: Towards Efficient LLM Serving via System-Aware KV Cache Optimization)
results.summary: Curated repository accompanying an ACL 2026 Findings survey, organizing KV cache work along temporal (scheduling/execution), spatial (placement/migration), and structural dimensions with dedicated sections on bandwidth-aware KV orchestration.
